ul.li: Keep the provided Create Agent, lifecycle, and Playground journey working.
Integrate middleware into a real backend/runtime path. Static screens do not count.
Demonstrate one positive case and one negative, failure, or denial case.
Use the one-line local Runtime and Ark from the Starter Kit. ECS is optional; Track C may additionally use veFaaS Cloud Sandbox.
Do not expose API Keys, AK/SK, passwords, or unredacted secrets in the browser, repository, logs, or demo.
Include automated evidence for the core middleware decision or event.

ol.li: Show the selected track and the protected/observed system boundary.
Create or select an Agent in the provided Web UI.
Run a normal coding task and show the expected result.
Trigger the track-specific failure, denial, or malicious case.
Show the middleware evidence: trace, policy decision, or isolation/termination result.
State one limitation and one next step.

p: The demo may use mock user data or a mock protected database. The Agent interaction, middleware decision, and evidence must be functional.
